I had my wisdom tooth extracted. During the procedure, the metal instrument hit my front tooth hard (luckily it didn't become loose, but it was very painful). After the extraction, one tooth developed decay. (I had a dental checkup near my home before the extraction.) The decayed tooth was a molar close to the wisdom tooth. I suspect the dentist made a mistake; they were supposed to be hitting the wisdom tooth but accidentally broke the nearby molar.

After getting the stitches removed near my home, I looked in the mirror and noticed a black spot on the broken molar. Today, it's clear that the tooth has a cavity; it's decayed. I'm very disappointed.
